device.type: Dual-tuner DVB-C Full HD H.265/HEVC cable receiver with Conax card reader, Ethernet and USB PVR
device.board: 72010A00 (bootloader version "M3716A 1.1.1", 8 MB SPI flash, 128 MB DDR3 C3505 dual-QAM cable platform)
device.soc: ALi M3716A / C3505 (128 MB DDR3 dual-CPU H.265/HEVC cable SoC reading chip ID 0x3505; NIM_S3281_0/1, NIM_QAM_S3202, DECV_HEVC_0, seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0xA6000200)
device.demod: internal ALi M3716A / S3281 dual DVB-C QAM demodulators (NIM_S3281_0, NIM_S3281_1)
device.tuner: Rafael Micro R858 dual-path DVB-C silicon tuner on SCB1 at I2C 0x6A

source.author: Amiko
source.note: Archive Amiko_HD8142_Twin-C_1.1.11_emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-03.

simulator.note: Boots as a 128 MB C3505 board (chips/c3505.py, run_dump_hd8142_twinc_1111_app_starts.py, run_dump_hd8142_twinc_1111_capture_screen.py; ALi M3716A is the dual-DVB-C cable package of C3505 silicon reading chip ID 0x3505 = "HW_TYPE_CHIP+80"): the boot-ROM bootloader runs at 0x9FE00800, writes " ON " to the CH455 panel on GPIO 107 / 108, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xA6000200 and maincode(AV) ("72010A001111") to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x86002001).  The application updates the CH455 panel to " on ", initialises both paths of the Rafael Micro R858 dual-path cable tuner on SCB1 at I2C 0x6A, populates userdb(64+64) from defaultdb(PRC) over SPI, and renders its OSD through the display engine's G1 CLUT8 layer at 0xB8006A00.

desc: EMU firmware 1.1.11 emu (System ID 72010A00) for the Amiko HD8142 Twin-C dual-tuner Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-C cable receiver on an 8 MB SPI flash with 128 MB DDR3.

Runs on the ALi M3716A cable SoC (C3505 silicon ID 0x3505 with internal NIM_S3281_0 / NIM_S3281_1 dual QAM demodulators and DECV_HEVC_0), paired with a Rafael Micro R858 dual-path silicon tuner (SCB1 0x6A) and a CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 107 / 108.
